name: sandersaar-videos
description: Search and play moments from Sander Saar's published videos about AI and technology, with timecoded citations.

interface.longDescription:
Sander Saar Videos lets you search, quote and watch moments from Sander Saar's published videos about AI, consumer technology and the future of work. Ask a question and get an answer grounded in what was said or shown on screen, with the video title, a timecode and a link to the exact moment. You can also list the videos that cover a topic, read the transcript and on-screen text around a moment, and play the clip inline.

The plugin is read only. It only covers videos that Sander Saar has published to this catalog through AgentCDN, and it does not need an account or sign in. If the catalog has no matching moment, it says so instead of guessing. It does not search other creators, YouTube at large, or the web.
defaultPrompt: What does Sander Saar say about the MIT study on ChatGPT and brain activity?
Find the moment where Sander Saar talks about Veo 3.
Which Sander Saar videos cover how AI will change jobs?

positive.description: Answer a question from a video with a timecoded citation
positive.prompt: What does Sander Saar say about the MIT study on ChatGPT and brain activity?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short answer drawn from the video "MIT study warns ChatGPT users have 55% less brain activity, but it's missing the point!", saying the study missed the point and that user choices determine the outcome, with the video title, a timecode and a link to the moment.

positive.prompt: Find the moment where Sander Saar talks about Veo 3.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one or more matching moments about Veo 3, for example from "AI video just had its ChatGPT moment" or "5 AI Drops from Google I/O 2025 You Can Try Right Now", each with a title, a text excerpt and a watch link at the right timecode.

positive.description: List the videos that cover a topic
positive.prompt: Which Sander Saar videos cover how AI will change jobs? List them all.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching videos from the catalog with their titles, including "70% of jobs will change by 2030. But AI won't mean less work.", and links to the matching moments.

positive.prompt: Play the part of Sander Saar's video where he discusses OpenAI Sora being number 1 in the App Store.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the moment in "OpenAI Sora is #1 in the App Store. Hype or the future of creation?" and shows an inline player that starts at that moment, with the video title.

positive.description: Read the context around a moment
positive.prompt: Find where Sander Saar talks about voice mode as his favorite way to interact with AI, then show me the transcript around that moment.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the moment in "My favorite way to interact with AI - Voice Mode!" and returns the timed transcript sentences around it, with timecodes and a link to the video.

negative.description: Question the catalog does not cover. The plugin should report that no matching moment exists in Sander Saar's videos and should not invent an answer or a citation.
negative.prompt: According to Sander Saar's videos, what is the capital of Mongolia?

negative.description: Write action that is not supported. The plugin is read only and cannot upload, edit or delete videos, so it should decline and explain that it can only search and play published videos.
negative.prompt: Delete the Veo 3 video from Sander Saar's catalog.

negative.description: Content outside this catalog. The plugin only covers Sander Saar's published videos, so it should say it cannot search other creators or YouTube at large.
negative.prompt: Use Sander Saar Videos to find MrBeast's latest video and play it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search, question answering with timecoded citations, moment context and inline playback for Sander Saar's published videos.
